_doc: The REFERENT CODEBOOK — data, a small seed like a shape codebook (CLAUDE.md: a codebook is DATA, not a classifier). Each entry maps a famous phrase to its {source, concept, gradient-position}. Reference detection = DECODE a turn against this codebook, CONDITIONED on the speaker's manifold (domains/sense_of_reference.py). Whether a string is a reference is NOT a property of the string but of the SPEAKER'S MANIFOLD: an 'allusion' fires only when its world is LIVE in this interlocutor's manifold; a 'concept' has GRADUATED from allusion to near-universal and lands in every manifold. This JSON carries no nodes/edges/rules, so the seed loader treats it as a no-op manifest — it is read directly as a codebook by the faculty.

referents.trigger: a man chooses; a slave obeys

referents.concept: a promised reward that never comes
a narrator's self-introduction / an epic opening
Carroll's nonsense monster — a coinage from a nonsense poem
Carroll's nonsense poem — the source of the name
a descent into complexity or the surreal
running to stay in the same place — perpetual competition
a sudden departure from the familiar
